post.description:
Email-verified machine bootstrap, with the same source/target rate limits.

The web login form uses Turnstile. Existing Agents cannot render that form,
so expose a dedicated email-only entrypoint; it grants no session or Agent
scope until the emailed token is verified. Email verification and configured domain restrictions still apply.
